foundation.overview: Account-it Consulting Services, LLC is a trusted partner for comprehensive tax and accounting services based in Boynton Beach, Florida. The firm specializes in tax preparation and planning for both individuals and businesses, ensuring clients navigate the complexities of the tax system with confidence.
foundation.businessModel: Service provider offering tax preparation, planning, QuickBooks services, and payroll for small businesses and individuals

positioning.pitch: Account-it Consulting Services, LLC is your top-rated tax partner, committed to maximizing your returns and minimizing your stress. We offer the expertise of a founder with over 14 years of experience as a CFO and controller, providing valuable business insights that go beyond simple accounting.
positioning.foundingStory: Founder Doug Cohen started his own accounting practice in South Florida in 2003. His experience includes years of public accounting and 14 years as a CFO/Controller. This background allows the firm to provide the service and support of a highly qualified CFO and Controller on a part-time or interim basis, without the high overhead costs of larger firms.

customerNeeds: Alleviate stress of complex tax returns and financial planning
Ensure tax compliance while legally reducing tax liabilities
Simplify payroll processing and ensure compliance
marketAndCustomers.idealPersona: Small business owner (1-10 employees) in the Boynton Beach, Florida area, at any stage from startup to mature business. Values trusted expertise and comprehensive services including QuickBooks management and payroll.

brandingAndStyle.writingStyle: Professional, reassuring, and client-focused. The language is clear and accessible, aimed at explaining complex tax and accounting concepts to individuals and small business owners. The tone is expert and trustworthy, highlighting experience and reliability to build confidence.

keyPeople.name: Doug Cohen
keyPeople.title: Founder and CPA
keyPeople.description: Founder of Account-it Consulting Services, LLC, with a career that includes over 14 years as a CFO and controller, as well as experience in public accounting. He is a CPA, a member of the AICPA, and a QuickBooks Certified ProAdvisor.

offerings.name: Tax Preparation & Planning
features: Individual, business, gift & estate, partnership, corporate, and out-of-state returns
Tax planning to minimize liability and maximize after-tax income
Comprehensive approach to identify overlooked deductions and credits
offerings.description: Professional tax preparation services for individuals and businesses. The service aims to simplify the complex tax code, identify overlooked deductions and credits, and ensure compliance.

offerings.name: Estate, Gift & Trust Return Preparation
features: Ensures compliance for fiduciaries and beneficiaries
Part of comprehensive tax preparation offerings
Specialized services for complex return types
offerings.description: Specialized tax preparation services for filing estate, gift, and trust returns.

offerings.name: QuickBooks Services
features: QuickBooks setup and configuration
Employee training
Ongoing support for questions (QuickAnswers)
Problem-solving services (QuickTuneup)
offerings.description: Expert assistance with QuickBooks to improve business efficiency and accuracy. The firm is a QuickBooks Certified ProAdvisor.

offerings.name: Payroll Services
features: Manages all payroll duties
Monitors federal, state, and local tax laws
Ensures secure data handling and transmission
offerings.description: Comprehensive payroll solutions for Florida businesses. Clients provide employee data, and the firm handles the rest.

offerings.name: IRS Tax Problem Resolution
features: Assistance with wage garnishments, bank levies, threatening letters
IRS audit representation
Non-filing issue resolution
Lien and offer-in-compromise assistance
Innocent spouse relief
offerings.description: Helps individuals and businesses resolve tax problems with the IRS. The service is efficient, affordable, and discrete.

offerings.name: Part-time/Interim CFO and Controller Services
features: High-level financial and accounting support on as-needed basis
Avoids cost of full-time executive salary
CFO and Controller expertise for strategic guidance
offerings.description: Offers the expertise of a qualified CFO and Controller without the full-time salary. This service is for businesses needing strategic financial guidance and oversight.

offerings.name: Accounting & Bookkeeping
features: Professional with 40 years of public accounting and CFO experience
Basic accounting and bookkeeping for smaller companies
Accurate financial record maintenance
offerings.description: Basic accounting and bookkeeping services for smaller companies. Ensures financial records are accurately maintained by an experienced CPA.

offerings.name: Business Start-Up Services
features: Complete list of commonly overlooked deductions
Help limit tax liability from the start
Specialized tax planning and education for new businesses
offerings.description: Specialized tax planning and education services to assist start-ups. Helps new businesses navigate tax compliance and implement tax-saving strategies.

uniqueSellingPropositions: 14+ years CFO/Controller experience at founder level
Expertise beyond simple accounting - strategic business guidance
Part-time CFO services without full executive overhead
thinkBigger.communityValues: Hands-on, personalized approach; commitment to client success over transaction volume
